column3: feat: add more ignore patterns to the ls tool
column11: list/ls tool skips more noise directories (coverage, vendor, tmp, cache, logs, venv/env).
column12: Extends IGNORE_PATTERNS in the ls (list) tool with .coverage, coverage/, vendor/, tmp/, temp/, .cache/, cache/, logs/, .venv/, venv/ and env/. Directory listings returned to the model now omit those trees, which shrinks output and changes what the agent sees.
column13: Feature extension of the default ignore list; nothing was broken. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: Update to a customized beast mode v3 for opencode.
column11: Update to a customized beast mode v3 for opencode.

column3: feat: allow read tool to handle images
column11: read tool returns images as attachments for image-capable models instead of erroring.
column12: Adds model modalities to provider metadata. When the active model supports image input, read on an image file now returns the image as a file attachment; before, it threw 'Use a different tool to process images'. Non-image models still get an error.
column13: New capability (issue #2657 is a feature request). Not reverted. The model-info plumbing was hardened later in #4473 (Nov 2025), outside the 2-week window.

column3: allow task tool to have resume capabilities
column11: task tool can resume an existing subagent session via session_id and returns that id in its output.
column12: Adds an optional session_id parameter to the task tool. If it is given, the subagent continues that session instead of starting a new one. Task output now ends with <task_metadata>session_id: ...</task_metadata>, and task.txt says invocations are stateless unless a session_id is supplied.
column13: New feature (resumable subagents). Not reverted; no follow-up fix found within 2 weeks.

column3: tweak: make bash give agent more awareness of cwd, bump default timeout, drop max timeout
column11: Bash tool gains a workdir parameter, default timeout goes from 1 to 2 min, and the 10-min max cap is dropped.
column12: Adds a 'workdir' parameter (description: 'Use this instead of cd'), checked against external-directory permission. DEFAULT_TIMEOUT changes from 60s to 120s and MAX_TIMEOUT (10 min) is removed, so model-requested timeouts are unbounded. bash.txt is updated to match.
column13: Deliberate defaults and feature change. Not reverted; #5676 (11 days later) removes a run_in_background mention that this PR did not add.

column3: Simplify directory tree output for prompts
column11: System-prompt project tree is a flat breadth-first list of directories, capped at 50 (was a 200-entry <files> tree).
column12: The environment section of the system prompt used to include a <files> tree of up to 200 entries. It now includes a <directories> block with a flat breadth-first list of directory paths only, limited to 50. This shrinks and restructures the initial repository context the model gets.
column13: Deliberate context-policy redesign ('simplify'); nothing was broken. Not reverted; no follow-up fix found.

column3: feat: adjust read tool so that it can handle dirs too
column11: read tool lists directory contents and uses XML-style <path>/<type>/<content> output blocks.
column12: read now stats the path. For a directory it returns a sorted entry listing with offset/limit paging; files are wrapped in <path>, <type> and <content> tags. edit.txt is updated to match the new read output and error wording.
column13: New capability plus an output-format redesign. Not reverted; later read.ts changes (#13198, #14009) are separate design and performance work.

column3: feat(tool): return image attachments from webfetch
column11: webfetch returns fetched images as image attachments instead of decoding them as text.
column12: When the HTTP response content-type is an image (excluding SVG), webfetch returns 'Image fetched successfully' plus a base64 data-URL file attachment that the model can view. Before, all bodies were decoded as text.
column13: New capability (a feature PR). Not reverted; #13890 later only moves attachment-id assignment.

column3: core: reduce prompts for shell, todowrite, and task tools
column11: Shell, todowrite and task tool descriptions and the fallback system prompt cut heavily (~280 lines removed).
column12: Removes the long git commit/PR protocol from shell.txt, shrinks todowrite.txt from about 211 lines to a short description, trims task.txt usage notes, and drops the terse-answer examples from default.txt. This greatly reduces tool-definition tokens; the body argues modern models don't need the detail.
column13: Deliberate prompt-reduction design change. Not reverted; #27872 changes the background-task text in task.txt (a separate flag-gated feature), not this reduction.
